questions.q: Find a word in paragraph 4 meaning 'full of people': the village can become very ___.

task: ¿Cómo sería tu ciudad con menos autos? Escribe 80–100 palabras con dos ventajas y un problema.
paragraphs: In the small Dutch village of Giethoorn, you will not hear car horns or engines. That is because there are almost no roads in the old part of the village. Instead, people travel along canals in small, quiet boats, or walk and cycle along narrow paths and over more than 170 wooden bridges.

Giethoorn was not designed as an environmental project. Centuries ago, workers dug canals to transport peat, a type of soil used as fuel. When the peat was gone, the canals stayed, and the villagers simply continued to use them. Today, the village is sometimes called "the Venice of the Netherlands".

For visitors, the lack of traffic is part of the magic. The air is clean, the gardens come right down to the water, and the only sounds are birds and the gentle noise of electric boat motors. Many tourists rent a "whisper boat", which is electric and makes very little noise.

However, life without cars is not always easy. Residents have to plan their shopping carefully, and heavy deliveries sometimes arrive by boat. In summer, the village can become very crowded: hundreds of thousands of tourists visit every year, and some residents complain that their peaceful home has turned into a theme park. The local council has introduced rules to control boat traffic and protect residents' privacy.

Even so, many urban planners see Giethoorn as an inspiration. While a city of millions cannot become a village of canals, the idea that streets can belong to people instead of cars is spreading around the world.
